items.title: Transfer must check identityRegistry.isVerified
items.desc: In `transfer` or `transferFrom`, the token must call `identityRegistry.isVerified` to ensure the recipient is eligible.
items.snippet: require(identityRegistry.isVerified(to), "ERC-3643: invalid identity");
items.policyRef: EIP-3643 specification — Token interface / transfer conditions (EIP doc) https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-3643
items.note: data.tokenIdentity is non-zero: 0xcf7ed3acca5a467e9e704c703e8d87f634fb0fc9; ABI has idr.isVerified(address): true

items.title: Token must call compliance.canTransfer hook
items.desc: Before executing transfers, token should invoke `compliance.canTransfer(from, to, amount)` to enforce additional compliance rules.
items.snippet: if (compliance != address(0)) require(compliance.canTransfer(from, to, amount), "ERC-3643: compliance failed");
items.policyRef: EIP-3643 spec — canTransfer in Token interface (EIP-3643) https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-3643
items.note: ABI has token.compliance(): true; data.tokenCompliance is non-zero: 0xdc64a140aa3e981100a9beca4e685f962f0cf6c9

items.title: ClaimTopicsRegistry must support add/remove and event emission
items.desc: Claim Topics Registry must expose `addClaimTopic`, `removeClaimTopic`, `getClaimTopics`, and emit `ClaimTopicAdded`/`ClaimTopicRemoved` events.
items.snippet: function addClaimTopic(uint256 _claimTopic); event ClaimTopicAdded(uint256 indexed claimTopic); function getClaimTopics() external view returns (uint256[] memory);
items.policyRef: ERC-3643 docs — Claim Topics Registry interface and events https://erc-3643.github.io/documentation/docs/suite/claim-topics-registry/ https://docs.erc3643.org
items.note: ABI has ctr.addClaimTopic(uint256): true; ABI has ctr.removeClaimTopic(uint256): true; ABI has ctr.getClaimTopics(): true

items.title: IdentityRegistry must support setter for ClaimTopicsRegistry
items.desc: Identity Registry should allow updating the associated ClaimTopicsRegistry via `setClaimTopicsRegistry(address)`.
items.snippet: function setClaimTopicsRegistry(address _claimTopics);
items.policyRef: ERC-3643 Identity Registry docs — setter methods https://erc-3643.github.io/documentation/docs/suite/identity-registry/ https://docs.erc3643.org
items.note: ABI has idr.setClaimTopicsRegistry(address): true

items.title: IdentityRegistry must support setter for TrustedIssuersRegistry
items.desc: Identity Registry must allow updating the Trusted Issuers Registry via `setTrustedIssuersRegistry(address)`.
items.snippet: function setTrustedIssuersRegistry(address _trustedIssuers);
items.policyRef: ERC-3643 Identity Registry docs — setter for trusted issuers https://erc-3643.github.io/documentation/docs/suite/identity-registry/
items.note: ABI has idr.setTrustedIssuersRegistry(address): true

items.title: Identity Registry must expose isVerified view function
items.desc: Identity Registry should have `isVerified(address)` to allow checking eligibility off-chain or from token.
items.snippet: function isVerified(address userAddress) external view returns (bool);
items.policyRef: ERC-3643 Identity Registry docs — isVerified definition https://erc-3643.github.io/documentation/docs/suite/identity-registry/
items.note: ABI has idr.isVerified(address): true

items.title: Token must emit IdentityRegistryAdded and ComplianceAdded
items.desc: Token should emit `IdentityRegistryAdded(address)` and `ComplianceAdded(address)` events when wiring these contracts.
items.snippet: event IdentityRegistryAdded(address indexed); event ComplianceAdded(address indexed);
items.policyRef: EIP-3643 specification — Token interface events list https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-3643
items.note: Event on token:IdentityRegistryAdded present: true; Event on token:ComplianceAdded present: true

items.title: Token must support freezing / unfreezing of address
items.desc: Token should implement `setAddressFrozen(address, bool)` or similar to control freezing of accounts.
items.snippet: function setAddressFrozen(address _who, bool _frozen);
items.policyRef: EIP-3643 standard mentions freeze/unfreeze in Token interface / events section https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-3643
items.note: ABI has token.setAddressFrozen(address,bool): true

items.title: Token must be compatible with ERC-20 interface
items.desc: ERC-3643 tokens must implement standard ERC-20 functions: `transfer`, `approve`, `allowance`, etc.
items.snippet: function transfer(address to, uint256 amount) external returns (bool); function approve(address spender, uint256 amount) external returns (bool);
items.policyRef: EIP-3643 spec (requires ERC-20 compatibility) https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-3643
items.note: ABI has token.totalSupply(): true; ABI has token.balanceOf(address): true; ABI has token.transfer(address,uint256): true; ABI has token.transferFrom(address,address,uint256): true; ABI has token.approve(address,uint256): true; ABI has token.allowance(address,address): true

items.title: Token must support recovery functionality
items.desc: Token should implement recovery mechanism in case an investor loses keys, e.g., `recover(address lost, address new)`.
items.snippet: function recover(address _lostWallet, address _newWallet);
items.policyRef: EIP-3643 specification — recovery function discussion in Token interface https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-3643
items.note: ABI has token.recover(address,address): false; ABI has token.recoveryAddress(address): false; ABI has token.setRecoveryAddress(address,address): false

items.title: Customer Due Diligence (CDD) before first transaction
items.desc: The system should enforce identity verification (KYC) before any token transfer is executed.
items.snippet: require(identityRegistry.isVerified(to), "HKMA: CDD not met");
items.policyRef: HKMA AML/CFT Guideline (2023) §3.4 Customer due diligence and verification https://brdr.hkma.gov.hk/eng/doc-ldg/docId/getPdf/20230525-3-EN/20230525-3-EN.pdf
items.note: data.tokenIdentity is non-zero: 0xcf7ed3acca5a467e9e704c703e8d87f634fb0fc9; ABI has token.identityRegistry(): true; ABI has idr.isVerified(address): true

items.title: Record keeping retention ≥ 5 years
items.desc: Audit or transaction logs must be kept for at least 5 years, retrievable on demand.
items.snippet: event Transfer(...); // logs stored on chain + offchain retention
items.policyRef: HKMA AML/CFT Guideline (2023) §9 Record keeping requirement https://brdr.hkma.gov.hk/eng/doc-ldg/docId/getPdf/20230525-3-EN/20230525-3-EN.pdf
items.note: Event on token:Transfer present: true

items.title: Beneficial ownership identification
items.desc: For entity accounts, beneficial owners must be identified and verified as part of KYC flow.
items.snippet: if (account.isEntity) require(identityRegistry.verifyBeneficialOwner(account, owner), "HKMA: BO not verified");
items.policyRef: HKMA AML/CFT Guideline §4.4 Beneficial owner identification https://brdr.hkma.gov.hk/eng/doc-key/guide (derived from general guidelines) https://brdr.hkma.gov.hk/eng/doc-ldg/docId/getPdf/20230525-3-EN/20230525-3-EN.pdf
items.note: ABI has idr.registerIdentity(address,address,uint16): true

items.title: Ongoing transaction monitoring / suspicious flags
items.desc: Transfers exceeding thresholds or patterns should trigger flags / review logic.
items.snippet: if (amount > threshold) emit SuspiciousTransfer(from, to, amount);
items.policyRef: HKMA AML/CFT Guideline §7 Transaction monitoring and reporting obligations https://brdr.hkma.gov.hk/eng/doc-ldg/docId/getPdf/20230525-3-EN/20230525-3-EN.pdf
items.note: data.tokenCompliance is non-zero: 0xdc64a140aa3e981100a9beca4e685f962f0cf6c9; data.complianceBoundToken equals cfg.token → (0x5fc8d32690cc91d4c39d9d3abcbd16989f875707 vs 0x5fc8d32690cc91d4c39d9d3abcbd16989f875707)

items.title: Freezing high-risk accounts or sanctions screening
items.desc: System supports freezing or blocking accounts identified as high risk or sanctioned.
items.snippet: function freezeAddress(address who) external onlyOwner;
items.policyRef: HKMA AML/CFT Guideline §5 Risk mitigation / enhanced due diligence https://brdr.hkma.gov.hk/eng/doc-ldg/docId/getPdf/20230525-3-EN/20230525-3-EN.pdf
items.note: ABI has token.setAddressFrozen(address,bool): true

items.title: Client identity rule: identity on file prior to transaction
items.desc: Before executing token-related operations, verify that client identity info is on file compliant with SFC §5.4.
items.snippet: require(identityRegistry.isVerified(to), "SFC: identity not on file");
items.policyRef: SFC Client Identity Rule Policy — Code of Conduct paragraph 5.4 https://www.sfc.hk/-/media/EN/assets/components/codes/files-previous/web/guidelines/client-identity-rule-policy/Client-Identity-Rule-Policy---2000-07-01-00_00_00.pdf
items.note: data.tokenIdentity is non-zero: 0xcf7ed3acca5a467e9e704c703e8d87f634fb0fc9; ABI has token.identityRegistry(): true; ABI has idr.isVerified(address): true

items.title: Timely disclosure of client identity to regulators
items.desc: Client identity records must be retrievable and deliverable to regulators within required timeframe.
items.snippet: function exportClientInfo(address who) external view returns (ClientInfo);
items.policyRef: SFC Client Identity Rule Policy — regulators can request identity info within 2 business days https://www.sfc.hk/-/media/EN/assets/components/codes/files-previous/web/guidelines/client-identity-rule-policy/Client-Identity-Rule-Policy---2000-07-01-00_00_00.pdf
items.note: ABI has idr.identity(address): true

items.title: Record changes in identity / KYC data
items.desc: When identity or KYC status changes, the system must emit an event for auditability.
items.snippet: event IdentityUpdated(address indexed who, string reason);
items.policyRef: SFC Code of Conduct §12 (Compliance obligations) — record keeping, control obligations https://www.sfc.hk/-/media/EN/assets/components/codes/files-previous/web/codes/code-of-conduct-for-persons-licensed-by-or-registered-with-the-securities-and-futures-commission/2011-08-31---2011-09-30---Code-of-Conduct-for-Per.pdf
items.note: ABI has idr.updateIdentity(address,address): true

items.title: Internal control & compliance function oversight
items.desc: The token-related operations must respect separation of roles, oversight, and error control.
items.snippet: // administrative actions only via governance or compliance module
items.policyRef: SFC Code of Conduct §12.1 General compliance obligations https://www.sfc.hk/-/media/EN/assets/components/codes/files-previous/web/codes/code-of-conduct-for-persons-licensed-by-or-registered-with-the-securities-and-futures-commission/2011-08-31---2011-09-30---Code-of-Conduct-for-Per.pdf
items.note: ABI has token.addAgent(address): true; ABI has token.removeAgent(address): true

items.title: Conflicts of interest disclosure & fairness
items.desc: If token logic includes privileged roles, their actions should be transparent via events or logs.
items.snippet: event AdminAction(address indexed who, string action);
items.policyRef: SFC Code of Conduct §5 & §11 (fair treatment, disclosure) https://www.sfc.hk/-/media/EN/assets/components/codes/files-previous/web/codes/code-of-conduct-for-persons-licensed-by-or-registered-with-the-securities-and-futures-commission/2011-08-31---2011-09-30---Code-of-Conduct-for-Per.pdf
items.note: Event on token:ComplianceAdded present: true
